jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
En Exportadora Data Base, contamos con más de 20 años de experiencia en servicios de Consultoría IT. Trabajamos siempre a la vanguardia en el campo de la innovación y la tecnología, tanto en la ingeniería de Software como en la consultoría tecnológica.

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de un Ingeniero de datos con 5 o más años de experiencia en proyectos de ingeniería de datos, calidad de datos y gobernanza de datos para cliente líder del Sector Tecnológico.

Requisitos:
• Habilidades sólidas en ingeniería de datos, integración de sistemas y gobernanza de datos, valorando especialmente la experiencia en entornos de nube AWS (AWS Glue, Glue Data Quality, Lake Formation y Data Zone).
• Experiencia en llamadas a APIs.
• Experiencia con otros hiperescalares y soluciones como Purview, Collibra o Anjana.
• Conocimiento de Metodologías Ágiles como Scrum.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Proyecto estable (indefinido).
• Modalidad híbrida (3 días teletrabajo, 2 presenciales) con residencia en Madrid.

Si crees... que puedes encajar en la oferta, no dudes en inscribirte

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
At Schwarz Global Services – Barcelona, we offer high value IT services for the entire Schwarz Group, which includes Lidl, Kaufland, Schwarz Produktion, PreZero, STACKIT and XMCyber. We are in the worldwide top 5 of Retail companies with 13.700 stores spread in 33 countries, more than 6 billion costumers, and over 575.000 employees. We strive to develop and implement smart and efficient IT solutions to deliver the best experience to our users, customers, and colleagues. We are looking for open-minded colleagues with passion for technology, who are willing to find diverse and exciting career opportunities in a dynamic work environment that stands for development and progress.

What You'll Do
• As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to bring data analytics to production at scale in LIDL. Taking part on data teams building data platforms or data products together with data science and data management teams.
• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines (batch and real time) from... different sources to insert high volumes of data in our lake and make data available for our stakeholders.
• Collaborate with other data team members in Data management and Data platform in order to implement and improve our data solutions.
• Data modelling: model our datasets to ease data consumptions for our stakeholders

What You'll Need
• Languages: Scala/Python and SQL
• Big Data Frameworks: Databricks, Spark
• Data Base: relational (SQL Server)
• CI/CD flows & tools: Azure DevOps
• Monitoring and alerting tools: Azure Monitoring, Grafana
• MS’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• 4+ years’ experience in software development
• 2+ years’ experience in Big Data Frameworks
• Experience in Agile methodology
• Experience with data workflow management tools like Airflow
• Experience in Cloud platforms, specially Microsoft Azure.
• As a bonus, contribution to open-source projects.

Nice to have
• Passion for learning new tools, languages and frameworks
• Ability to be creative and innovation-minded, self-motivated and proactive.
• Fast adaptation to changing requirements and strong problem-solving skills.
• To work in a collaborative model, side by side with the business.
• The position requires fluency in English and effective collaboration in English-speaking teams.

What We Offer
• You will be part of an international team composed by people from different countries and backgrounds, where you’ll be able to share your experience and knowledge to carry-out team work and meet the objectives.
• On top of this, you’ll have a personal follow-up with your management team to help you understanding all business-related questions and guide you in your professional career.
• We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package: lunch vouchers, health and dental insurance, transport, wellbeing, etc.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Schwarz Global Services
• Laura Hernandez Costa
• Reference no. 42146 C/Bergara 13, floor 5, 08002 Barcelona es.it.schwarz

jobs_results.title: Aerospace Data Management Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are Bertrandt.

An independent and international development service provider with long years of automotive expertise. With cross-industry know-how and a holistic understanding of systems and products, we create technological solutions at any stage of the product development process.

We deal with a focus on hot topics such as digitalization, e-mobility and autonomous systems, mainly for the automotive, aerospace and mechanical engineering sectors, and consistently facilitate the development of tailored solutions in these areas.

Our goal: to accelerate technological progress and make a relevant contribution to a sustainable future. We work on this every day – with around 14,000 employees at more than 50 sites worldwide.

Your responsibility:

You will be part of a project related to data management in Aerospace field.

We are looking for an engineer who will be responsible for generating the database applicable for the aircraft, collecting data from several sources (for instance... maintenance, materials, configuration) according to customer's needs.

Furthermore, a verification of the data compilation carried out will be required, ensuring integrity and consistency of database obtained by using some tools. A deep understanding of aeronautics processes is necessary for this position.

What are we looking for?

-Degree in aeronautics, industrial. Although we do not rule out any training around office tools and databases.

-Previous experience in Aerospace field working with data will ve highly valued.

-Previous experience working with Excel / VBA and/or with Access will be highly valued.

-Also, previous experience / knowledge of Python, SQL, Access... will be highly valued.

What do we offer to you?

- Competitive salary, it depends on your experience!

- Permanent contract.

- Initial and continous training.

- Flexible retribution plan includes: private insurance, kindergarten ticket and public transport card.

- 23 working days of holidays + company days off!

- Young and dynamic environment: even the olders are young inside!

Whether as a working student, as a graduate or as a professional – just make your next career step and apply today! We are waiting for you :)

(Ref. 2024-L-02

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a Big Data
jobs_results.description:
Are you looking for an innovative and consolidated position as a professional development? GMV is a technological group with extensive experience.

We are expanding our Intelligent Transport Systems team to participate in public transport projects.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Our team can participate in the development of predictive solutions and the continued improvement of operations and services, through the interpretation and application of volumes of data in a public transport context, carrying out functions such as:
• Design, construction and maintenance of the data infrastructure and data bases.
• Development and optimization of ETL processes to integrate, transform and load data.
• Analyze data to identify trends, perform statistical analysis and generate information and visualizations.
• Discover machine learning models to predict trends and... behaviors.
• Creation and maintenance of dashboards and implementations of BI to facilitate the access and understanding of data for part of the final users.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this reason, we are buscando experts who have a stable environment in which to start, with trays and experience in:
• Implementation and deployment of predictive models in production (Python FastAPI, .NET core, C++, etc.).
• Phyton data-stack (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Pytorch, etc.)
• ETL transfers and database platforms.
• Statistic analysis.
• Understanding of the principles of machine learning and the ability to implement predictive models.
• Technical fundamentals of optimization techniques (non-convex optimization with gradient descent, heuristics, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming, discrete optimization, etc.).

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Clara Sanchez Lobato, in charge of this vacancy.

Clara Sanchez Lobato

jobs_results.description:
✨¿Quieres ser protagonista de soluciones que impacten a nivel global? ¡Forma parte del cambio!

💚 Somos Softtek, un grupo tecnológico global que integra una cultura única, beneficios y un gran desarrollo, tanto profesional como humano, con presencia en más de 20 países y 14 sedes en España. Generamos valor a través de la tecnología y nuestro objetivo es dejar huella y trascender en el ámbito de la transformación digital. Ya sumamos más 16.000 softtekians alrededor del mundo y seguimos creciendo.

En 2023 hemos sido reconocidos por la Lista Forbes como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España, destacando por la flexibilidad y la personalización de la experiencia del empleado. Creemos que las personas con talento y autodeterminación son capaces de crear cosas asombrosas. ¿Nos acompañas en esta aventura? #FutureTogether

🔎¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos Senior Data Engineer con amplia experiencia en Python y Spark.

¿Qué necesitamos?
• Conocimientos y experencia contrastada en... arquitecturas big data.
• Conocimientos consolidados en procesamiento de datos con spark batch y streaming
• Conocimientos kafka.
• Arquitectura cloud AWS, EMR, Lambdas, iceberg, delta parquets
• Programacion en scala funcional: cats, doobbie,zio, akka
• Programacion python

✅¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido.

👪 Posibilidad de teletrabajo, horario flexible y mejoras para favorecer la conciliación a través de nuestro programa BetterWork.

✈️24 días de vacaciones

🩺 Seguro médico

Retribución flexible: tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería o seguro médico familiares.

🎂 Tarde de cumpleaños libre (también por el cumple de tus hijos)

Club del empleado: ofertas y promociones exclusivas por ser Softtekian.

🎓 Planes de formación: idiomas, tecnologías y soft skills

🌍 Oportunidad de movilidad interna: contamos con presencia internacional y diversas sedes en España

👀 ¿Todavía sigues aquí?

¡Tu incorporación es nuestra prioridad! No dudes en apuntarte, estamos deseando conocerte.

Valoraremos especialmente la candidatura de personas que posean habilidades y capacidades únicas y diversas, reconociendo la importancia de facilitar su integración plena en el mercado laboral. Cada individuo, con sus capacidades singulares, aporta una riqueza invaluable a nuestra comunidad, y nuestro compromiso es asegurar que todos tengan la oportunidad de demostrar su valía y contribuir al crecimiento y la diversidad de nuestro equipo”

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
En IT Partner, estamos buscando dos talentosos Data Engineers con 5 años de experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo en Madrid. Esta es una oportunidad emocionante para formar parte de proyectos innovadores y trabajar en un ambiente colaborativo y dinámico.
• Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de datos eficientes.
• Desarrollar soluciones utilizando Python con enfoque funcional para manejo de datos.
• Experiencia sólida en bases de datos relacionales y SQL.
• Creación y mantenimiento de pipelines de datos utilizando REST y SOAP APIs.
• Experiencia en control de versiones utilizando Git y CI/CD con enfoque multi-rama.

Ofrecemos:
• Salario competitivo acorde a experiencia y habilidades.
• Ambiente de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y formación continua.
• Trabajar en proyectos innovadores y desafiantes junto a un equipo experimentado.

¡Si buscas un nuevo reto profesional donde puedas desarrollar tus habilidades como Data Engineer, esta es tu... oportunidad! ¡Envía tu CV ahora y únete a IT Partner para hacer un impacto significativo en el mundo de la tecnología!

Requisitos:

Requisitos Deseables:
• Exposición a DBT será altamente valorada.
• Conocimientos en Spark.
• Familiaridad con tecnologías de data streaming.
• Comprensión sólida de Arquitectura y Modelado de Datos: Debes tener un sólido entendimiento de cómo diseñar y estructurar arquitecturas de datos eficientes.
• Programación en Python para Datos (Enfoque Funcional): Experiencia en el desarrollo de soluciones utilizando Python con un enfoque funcional para el manejo de datos.
• Experiencia en Bases de Datos Relacionales y SQL: Debes tener experiencia previa trabajando con bases de datos relacionales y un dominio sólido de SQL.
• Exposición previa a APIs REST y SOAP (para Pipelines de Datos / ETL): Experiencia previa en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de pipelines de datos utilizando tanto APIs REST como SOAP.
• Git & CI/CD (Enfoque de Ramas Múltiples): Experiencia en control de versiones utilizando Git y prácticas de integración y entrega continua (CI/CD) con un enfoque de múltiples ramas.

Ubicación: Madrid (3 días presenciales, 2 remoto)

Experiencia Requerida: 5 años

Nivel de Inglés Requerido: C1

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer especializado en Gobernanza de Datos
jobs_results.description:
Desde Grupo NS necesitamos incorporar un Ingeniero de Datos especializado en gobernanza técnica del dato para un proyecto en modalidad Híbrida (MADRID)

Es esencial tener experiencia comprobada en ingeniería de datos y llamadas a APIs (mínimo 2 años), así como un conocimiento profundo de herramientas de gobernanza de datos.

La experiencia en el stack AWS, especialmente en AWS Glue, Glue Data Quality, Lake Formation y Data Zone (Mínimo 3 años a excepción de Data Zone), es muy deseable.

• Al menos tres años de experiencia como Ingenerio de Datos especializado en gobernanza del dato
• Experiencia de al menos tres años en AWS
• Residir en Madrid ya que la modalidad es 100% teletrabajo

jobs_results.title: Vulnerability Management Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
At Schwarz Global Services – Barcelona, we offer high value IT services for the entire Schwarz Group, which includes Lidl, Kaufland, Schwarz Produktion, PreZero, STACKIT and XMCyber. We are in the worldwide top 5 of Retail companies with 13.700 stores spread in 33 countries, more than 6 billion costumers, and over 575.000 employees. We strive to develop and implement smart and efficient IT solutions to deliver the best experience to our users, customers, and colleagues. We are looking for open-minded colleagues with passion for technology, who are willing to find diverse and exciting career opportunities in a dynamic work environment that stands for development and progress.

Project
• We are in the process of providing a new vulnerability management platform and Python is our programming language of choice.
• You will be able to participate in the different parts of the project such as architecture design and the development of a solution that processes millions of data entries... daily.
• It is an opportunity to work with a highly skilled team, with a nice environment where you will have the opportunity to bring your own ideas.

What You'll Do
• As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to bringing data analytics to production at scale in Schwarz group. Taking part in the design and implementation of the Vulnerability Management Platform or other related data products.
• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines (batch and real time) from different sources to insert high volumes of data in our data lake and make data available for our stakeholders.
• Collaborate with other data team members in Data management and Data platform to implement and improve our data solutions.
• Data modelling: model our datasets to ease data consumption for our stakeholders.

What You'll Need
• Practical experience building scalable software using advanced Python and SQL.
• Familiarity building data processing pipelines (ELT) using tools such as Airbyte, Airflow, dbt or similar tools.
• Database: relational (PostgreSQL) and non-relational (MongoDB, Redis), experience with graph oriented DBs (Neo4j) is a plus.
• Experience with cloud data warehousing solutions (preferably Snowflake or Azure).
• At minimum user level experience with Unix/Linux.
• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g: Docker, Kubernetes).
• CI/CD Pipeline: Azure DevOps, Jira.
• Monitoring and data visualization tools: Azure Monitoring, Grafana, PowerBI.
• MS’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 3+ years’ experience in software development.
• 3+ years’ experience in Big Data Frameworks.
• Experience in Agile methodology.
• As a bonus, contribution to open-source projects.

Nice to have
• Passion for learning new tools, languages, and frameworks.
• Ability to be creative and innovation-minded, self-motivated, and proactive.
• Fast adaptation to changing requirements and strong problem-solving skills.
• To work in a collaborative model, side by side with the business.
• The position requires fluency in English and effective collaboration in English-speaking teams.

What We Offer
• You will be part of an international team composed by people from different countries and backgrounds, where you’ll be able to share your experience and knowledge to carry-out teamwork and meet the objectives.
• On top of this, you’ll have a personal follow-up with your management team to help you understand all business-related questions and guide you in your professional career.
• We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package: lunch vouchers, health and dental insurance, transport, wellbeing, etc.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Schwarz Global Services
• Alba Serra Cardona
• Reference no. 42239 C/Bergara 13, floor 5, 08002 Barcelona es.it.schwarz
